contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DNVALENTINI[IAN]VS PF AVG ; R/ SECVRITAS REIPUBLICAE

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375). Obverse description: Diademed and draped bust right. Obverse inscription: DNVALENTINI[IAN]VS PF AVG Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath Reverse inscription: SECVRITAS REIPUBLICAE Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.48mm, Weight: 2.00gms, die axis: 12
